title: The held letter on Tonight
note: The Keep sheet said the letter waits on Tonight, and it does: its own card, with the words as typed, says "Waiting to be kept." and "Keep it".
text: Asha · 0 days Good afternoon, Mama. What do you want Asha to know about today? Another thought Friday You waved at the dog on the corner. Waiting to be kept. Keep it Speak Type Not much today Tonight Book Family
lines: What do you want Asha to know about today?
You waved at the dog on the corner.
